round_definition: One bank/index round, both Flash and Black, both Raw and MSDF; includes unchanged KID.
old_timing_source: Measured replay of ten completed legacy rounds using the original 2048-dimensional torch-fidelity FID, plus unchanged KID; not inferred from approximate user wall time.
new_timing_scope: Feature slicing, both lowrank FIDs and both KIDs per class; excludes process startup, validation, SQLite/CSV I/O and other D1 diagnostics.
lowrank_FID_evaluations_scope: Committed formal rows only; a killed, uncommitted calculation is not a result and may be retried.
